key: Ho there, stranger.
en: Ho there, stranger.
ja: よお、そこの見慣れない顔。

key: Welcome to the club-- but I'm afraid it's no entry for the commonfolk.
en: Welcome to the club-- but I'm afraid it's no entry for the commonfolk.
ja: クラブへようこそ――でも悪いが、一般人は入れないんだ。

key: If you want into this gig, gotta win this gig.
en: If you want into this gig, gotta win this gig.
ja: このイベントに入りたきゃ、このイベントに勝つ必要があるぜ。

key: There's a free pass for leaders and other league staff, but you gotta beat the league if you wanna hear these beats.
en: There's a free pass for leaders and other league staff, but you gotta beat the league if you wanna hear these beats.
ja: リーダーやリーグ関係者には無料パスがあるが、このビートを聞きたきゃリーグを倒す必要がある。

key: Not great for business, I know, but hey,
en: Not great for business, I know, but hey,
ja: 商売的には良くないってわかってるが、まあいいさ、

key: If the city wants to subsidize us, that's their problem, not ours.
en: If the city wants to subsidize us, that's their problem, not ours.
ja: 街が俺たちに補助金出したいってんなら、それは向こうの問題で、こっちの問題じゃない。

key: Now scram, buddy.
en: Now scram, buddy.
ja: さあ行きな、相棒。

key: I'll root for you to get in here one day-- but don't hold your breath.
en: I'll root for you to get in here one day-- but don't hold your breath.
ja: いつかあんたがここに入れるよう応援してるぜ――でも息を止めて待つなよ。

key: You again, huh?
en: You again, huh?
ja: また来たのか、あんた?

key: Didn't you hear what I said before?
en: Didn't you hear what I said before?
ja: 前に言ったこと聞いてなかったのか?

key: This crib's for league staff and champions only.
en: This crib's for league staff and champions only.
ja: ここはリーグ関係者とチャンピオンだけの場所だ。

key: Welcome, stranger.
en: Welcome, stranger.
ja: ようこそ、見慣れない顔。

key: I hear there's a few people expecting you.
en: I hear there's a few people expecting you.
ja: 何人か、あんたを待ってる人がいるって聞いてるぜ。

key: Best not keep them waiting.
en: Best not keep them waiting.
ja: 待たせない方がいいだろうな。

key: Welcome back, friend.
en: Welcome back, friend.
ja: おかえり、相棒。

key: I'll tell you something-- A lot of people wander in here.
en: I'll tell you something-- A lot of people wander in here.
ja: 一つ言っとくとな――ここにはたくさんの人がふらっとやってくる。

key: And when you first did, if someone told me you were gonna be the one to beat the league and save the region, I wouldn't have believed 'em.
en: And when you first did, if someone told me you were gonna be the one to beat the league and save the region, I wouldn't have believed 'em.
ja: あんたが初めてここに来たとき、あんたがリーグを倒してこの地方を救う人物になるなんて言われても、俺は信じなかっただろうな。

key: But here you are.
en: But here you are.
ja: でも、あんたはここにいる。

key: And here you belong.
en: And here you belong.
ja: そして、あんたはここにふさわしい。

key: I'll keep rooting for you from here as long as you keep doing whatever it is you gotta do.
en: I'll keep rooting for you from here as long as you keep doing whatever it is you gotta do.
ja: あんたがやるべきことをやり続ける限り、俺はここから応援し続けるぜ。

key: ARC: \PN! It's been a minute.
en: ARC: \PN! It's been a minute.
ja: アーク: \PN! 久しぶりだな。

key: That whole thing at Devon before was kinda rough, huh?
en: That whole thing at Devon before was kinda rough, huh?
ja: デボンでのあの一件は、なかなかキツかったよな?

key: I'm still gettin' used to this whole one-eyed thing,
en: I'm still gettin' used to this whole one-eyed thing,
ja: まだこの片目の状態には慣れてないとこだけど、

key: But I gotta realize they could've done a lot worse.
en: But I gotta realize they could've done a lot worse.
ja: もっとひどいことになってたかもって、わからないといけないよな。

key: And I could've--
en: And I could've--
ja: それに、俺だって――

key: Well, it's not like I'd have wished this on you.
en: Well, it's not like I'd have wished this on you.
ja: まあ、こんなことをあんたに望んでたわけじゃないんだ。

key: Not that I'm trying to play the martyr here. I think we've had more than enough of that.
en: Not that I'm trying to play the martyr here. I think we've had more than enough of that.
ja: 別に殉教者気取ってるわけじゃないぜ。そういうのはもう十分すぎるくらいあったと思うしな。

key: But hey, you see Team Meteor, you give 'em one for me.
en: But hey, you see Team Meteor, you give 'em one for me.
ja: でもよ、チームメテオを見かけたら、俺の分も一発かましてくれ。

key: For now I'm just trying to get back on track, you heard it?
en: For now I'm just trying to get back on track, you heard it?
ja: 今んとこ、俺はただ元の調子を取り戻そうとしてるとこだ、聞いてくれよ?

key: So I was doing a bit of follow-up on the Pokémon trafficking around 7th.
en: So I was doing a bit of follow-up on the Pokémon trafficking around 7th.
ja: それで、7番街周辺のポケモン密輸の件を少し追ってたんだが。

key: I heard you bought those up while I was out.
en: I heard you bought those up while I was out.
ja: 俺がいない間に、あんたがそれを買い取ってくれたって聞いた。

key: I appreciate that.
en: I appreciate that.
ja: 感謝してるぜ。

key: They've got no business staying in the market, and I can trust you'll take care of them.
en: They've got no business staying in the market, and I can trust you'll take care of them.
ja: あんな連中が市場にいちゃいけないし、あんたなら面倒見てくれるって信頼できる。

key: Oh, I actually wanted to hand this off to you as a 'thanks' for that.
en: Oh, I actually wanted to hand this off to you as a 'thanks' for that.
ja: あ、そうだ、その礼にこれをあんたに渡したかったんだ。

key: ARCLIGHT: Did you already know they were stolen from Obsidia's Daycare?
en: ARCLIGHT: Did you already know they were stolen from Obsidia's Daycare?
ja: アークライト: それが、オブシディアの託児所から盗まれたものだって、もう知ってたか?

key: Did you already know they were stolen from Obsidia's Daycare?
en: Did you already know they were stolen from Obsidia's Daycare?
ja: それが、オブシディアの託児所から盗まれたものだって、もう知ってたか?

key: I want to get those Pokémon back to their original owners.
en: I want to get those Pokémon back to their original owners.
ja: そのポケモンたちを、元の飼い主に返してやりたいんだ。

key: Thanks to the cooperation of the Day-Care Couple I've been able to track down five of the Trainers who had their Pokémon stolen.
en: Thanks to the cooperation of the Day-Care Couple I've been able to track down five of the Trainers who had their Pokémon stolen.
ja: 託児所の夫婦が協力してくれたおかげで、ポケモンを盗まれたトレーナーのうち五人を突き止めることができたぜ。

key: Turns out, the couple running it were dupes, and the real ones had been captured.
en: Turns out, the couple running it were dupes, and the real ones had been captured.
ja: 結局、あそこを運営してた夫婦は偽者で、本物は捕らえられてたんだ。

key: Fortunately, I was able to set 'em straight.
en: Fortunately, I was able to set 'em straight.
ja: 幸い、俺がちゃんと元に戻せたけどな。

key: And what's more, thanks to the cooperation of the original Day-Care Couple I've been able to track down five of the Trainers who had their Pokémon stolen.
en: And what's more, thanks to the cooperation of the original Day-Care Couple I've been able to track down five of the Trainers who had their Pokémon stolen.
ja: それに、元の託児所の夫婦の協力のおかげで、ポケモンを盗まれたトレーナーのうち五人を突き止めることができたぜ。

key: So, that means all that's left to do is for you to make the deliveries. No problem, right?
en: So, that means all that's left to do is for you to make the deliveries. No problem, right?
ja: つまり、あとはあんたが配達するだけってことだ。問題ないよな?

key: 'Course, I know better than to expect work for nothing.
en: 'Course, I know better than to expect work for nothing.
ja: もちろん、ただ働きさせようなんて思っちゃいないぜ。

key: Once this is all done, I have something real nice for you.
en: Once this is all done, I have something real nice for you.
ja: これが全部終わったら、あんたにいいものを用意してあるからな。

key: If you're all set, just ask me for the list of who's who.
en: If you're all set, just ask me for the list of who's who.
ja: 準備ができたら、誰が誰かのリストを聞いてくれ。

key: ARC: All right, here's everyone who needs their Pokémon still.
en: ARC: All right, here's everyone who needs their Pokémon still.
ja: アーク: よし、これがまだポケモンを必要としてる人たちの一覧だ。

key: Lillin, from Jasper Ward, lost a Loudred.
en: Lillin, from Jasper Ward, lost a Loudred.
ja: ジャスパーワードのリリンは、ワンリキーをなくした。

key: Felicia, a student at Apophyll Academy, was the owner of a Makuhita.
en: Felicia, a student at Apophyll Academy, was the owner of a Makuhita.
ja: アポフィルアカデミーの生徒、フェリシアは、マクノシタの飼い主だった。

key: There's Mr. McKrezzy from the Lapis Ward. He lost a Roggenrola.
en: There's Mr. McKrezzy from the Lapis Ward.  He lost a Roggenrola.
ja: ラピスワードのマクレジー氏。彼はイシヘンジンをなくした。

key: A Santiago from the Peridot Ward had a Jigglypuff stolen from him.
en: A Santiago from the Peridot Ward had a Jigglypuff stolen from him.
ja: ペリドットワードのサンティアゴは、プリンを盗まれた。

key: Last but not least, Eustace, also from the Lapis Ward, owned the Vanillite.
en: Last but not least, Eustace, also from the Lapis Ward, owned the Vanillite.
ja: 最後に、同じくラピスワードのユースタスは、バニプッチの飼い主だった。

key: That's everyone.
en: That's everyone.
ja: これで全員だ。

key: Let me know when you've gotten all of the Pokémon returned.
en: Let me know when you've gotten all of the Pokémon returned.
ja: ポケモンを全員に返し終わったら教えてくれ。

key: ARC: How's it going? You able to track 'em down?
en: ARC: How's it going? You able to track 'em down?
ja: アーク: どんな調子だ? ちゃんと見つけられたか?

key: One of them wants what?
en: One of them wants what?
ja: そのうちの一人が欲しいって言ってるのは何だ?

key: Ahah... Well, sure, no problem.
en: Ahah... Well, sure, no problem.
ja: ああ……まあ、いいさ、問題ない。

key: She shoulda just said something in the first place.
en: She shoulda just said something in the first place.
ja: 最初からそう言ってくれりゃよかったのにな。

key: Though, it's sorta embarrassing for me, too...
en: Though, it's sorta embarrassing for me, too...
ja: まあ、こっちも少し気まずいんだけどよ……

key: Here.
en: Here.
ja: ほら。

key: ARC: Seriously, prioritizing a signature over a Pokémon...
en: ARC: Seriously, prioritizing a signature over a Pokémon...
ja: アーク: マジかよ、ポケモンよりサインを優先するなんて……

key: But I can't be mad at her.
en: But I can't be mad at her.
ja: でも、彼女に怒る気にはなれないな。

key: Give 'er my regards.
en: Give 'er my regards.
ja: よろしく伝えといてくれ。

key: ARC: So, that's everyone, is it?
en: ARC: So, that's everyone, is it?
ja: アーク: それで、これで全員か?

key: It's a shame about the other Trainers that I wasn't able to contact, but I've done all I can.
en: It's a shame about the other Trainers that I wasn't able to contact, but I've done all I can.
ja: 連絡が取れなかった他のトレーナーたちには悪いが、俺にできることはやりきったよ。

key: For the Pokémon that were left over, it's up to you to take good care of them now.
en: For the Pokémon that were left over, it's up to you to take good care of them now.
ja: 残ったポケモンについては、これからはあんたがちゃんと面倒見てやってくれ。

key: I dunno how many people would've been as cool with it as you've been.
en: I dunno how many people would've been as cool with it as you've been.
ja: あんたほどこの件に協力的な奴、他にどれだけいたかわかんねえよ。

key: So, this is for you.
en: So, this is for you.
ja: だから、これはあんたにやるよ。

key: ARC: Stay real, friend.
en: ARC: Stay real, friend.
ja: アーク: 元気でな、相棒。

key: ARC: I'll see you again sometime.
en: ARC: I'll see you again sometime.
ja: アーク: またいつか会おうぜ。

key: Jolteon seems interested in you.
en: Jolteon seems interested in you.
ja: サンダースがあなたに興味を持っているようだ。

key: JOLTEON: Jolt!
en: JOLTEON: Jolt!
ja: サンダース: サンダ!

key: Pet Jolteon?
en: Pet Jolteon?
ja: サンダースをなでますか?

key: JOLTEON: Jolteon!
en: JOLTEON: Jolteon!
ja: サンダース: サンダース!

key: The static shock from its fur makes your hand go numb.
en: The static shock from its fur makes your hand go numb.
ja: その毛皮の静電気に触れて、手がしびれた。

key: Jolteon make a small growl as its fur bristles slightly.
en: Jolteon make a small growl as its fur bristles slightly.
ja: サンダースは毛を少し逆立てて、小さくうなった。

key: Jolteon remembers you!
en: Jolteon remembers you!
ja: サンダースはあなたのことを覚えている!

key: JOLTEON: Jolt! Jolt!
en: JOLTEON: Jolt! Jolt!
ja: サンダース: サンダ! サンダ!

key: It gives you 100 static shocks in appreciation.
en: It gives you 100 static shocks in appreciation.
ja: 感謝の印に、100回分の静電気ショックをくれた。

key: You start to move away, but Jolteon insists on getting that pet. It zaps your hand to mark the occasion.
en: You start to move away, but Jolteon insists on getting that pet. It zaps your hand to mark the occasion.
ja: 離れようとするが、サンダースはまだなでてほしいと言わんばかりだ。記念にと、あなたの手にビリッと電気を放った。

key: Tier 1 selected
en: Tier 1 selected
ja: ティア1を選択

key: Tier 2 selected
en: Tier 2 selected
ja: ティア2を選択

key: Tier 3 selected
en: Tier 3 selected
ja: ティア3を選択

key: Tier 4 selected
en: Tier 4 selected
ja: ティア4を選択

key: Tier 5 selected
en: Tier 5 selected
ja: ティア5を選択

key: Tier 6 selected
en: Tier 6 selected
ja: ティア6を選択

key: Tier 6.5 selected
en: Tier 6.5 selected
ja: ティア6.5を選択

key: Tier 7 selected
en: Tier 7 selected
ja: ティア7を選択

key: Tier 8 selected
en: Tier 8 selected
ja: ティア8を選択

key: HEATHER: There you are.
en: HEATHER: There you are.
ja: ヘザー: あ、いた。

key: You're kinda hard to find sometimes, you know?
en: You're kinda hard to find sometimes, you know?
ja: あんたって時々、ほんと見つけにくいよね?

key: Can't you just wait in one spot like the rest of us?
en: Can't you just wait in one spot like the rest of us?
ja: あたしたちみたいに一箇所でじっと待ってられないの?

key: That's a joke. Waiting around is way too boring.
en: That's a joke. Waiting around is way too boring.
ja: なんてね、冗談だよ。待ってるのなんて超退屈だし。

key: So anyway, I was supposed to tell you that Noel is looking for you.
en: So anyway, I was supposed to tell you that Noel is looking for you.
ja: それはそうと、ノエルがあんたを探してるって伝えるように言われたんだ。

key: He's up in his treehouse thing or whatever.
en: He's up in his treehouse thing or whatever.
ja: あの子、自分のツリーハウスみたいなとこにいるよ。

key: I appreciate the, like, creative vision or whatever, but also looking at that place makes me want to throw up juuuuust a little bit.
en: I appreciate the, like, creative vision or whatever, but also looking at that place makes me want to throw up juuuuust a little bit.
ja: 独創的なセンスっていうか何ていうか、それは尊重するけど、あの場所見ると、ちょっとだけ吐きそうになるんだよね。

key: Better than him being all mopey though, that's for sure...
en: Better than him being all mopey though, that's for sure...
ja: まあ、あの子がずっと落ち込んでるよりはマシだけどさ、それは間違いないよ……

key: Anyway, treehouse. Message delivered, bye!
en: Anyway, treehouse. Message delivered, bye!
ja: とにかく、ツリーハウスね。伝言終わり、じゃあね!

key: Sup.
en: Sup.
ja: よっす。

key: You know something?
en: You know something?
ja: 一つ知ってる?

key: I heard the DJ of this club has a Mega Ring.
en: I heard the DJ of this club has a Mega Ring.
ja: このクラブのDJ、メガリングを持ってるらしいよ。

key: Well, not just one Mega Ring.
en: Well, not just one Mega Ring.
ja: しかも、一個だけじゃなくて。

key: A spare one.
en: A spare one.
ja: 予備が一個。

key: Think he could be convinced to part with it?
en: Think he could be convinced to part with it?
ja: それ、手放してもらえるように説得できると思う?

key: Put in a good word for me, okay~?
en: Put in a good word for me, okay~?
ja: あたしのためにちょっといい言葉かけといてね～?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
